selection: all applications, placements, laws and operations with original repetition=0; all 27 prespecified artificial positions
method_order: rotate methods left by (case_index+round) modulo 5; cases lexicographic
output_contract: six variants and five contrasts, exact endpoint fractions and statuses; no witness output for any timed backend
reuse: one current prepared object per case stream; exact semantic-key byte comparison on every snapshot; no memoized final answers or category extrema
reuse_key: all fields determining predicates and coordinate correspondence, excluding frequencies, masks and nonsemantic metadata
updates: declared artificial transformations of saved models; no new observations or independent campaigns
construction_boundary: already loaded model through semantic-key check, optional representation construction and one complete query
stage_costs: key check, representation construction, backend data update and inference; CPU and wall measured for every snapshot
memory_scope: GNU time peak RSS of a fresh case/method/round process over all seven updates, including imports, input load and verification; not per-snapshot memory
bayesian_intervals: proved full-support Boolean oracle with LazyPropagation; uniform missing bits only in the auxiliary support law, never imputed target probabilities; not a generic native credal-network algorithm
bayesian_arithmetic: native double exact-inference algorithm; both posterior cells inspected separately for zero; identified point posterior checked within 1e-12; endpoint aggregation rational
markov_intervals: exact-rational finite DTMC when no nondeterministic choices; otherwise MDP Pmin/Pmax reachability; no invented continuous-time rates
markov_compression: retain controls until determined; thereafter keep the output-function pair for completion conjunction 0/1; prefix completion failures terminate
scope: computation on fixed joint empirical models; independent identification accuracy and full telemetry reconstruction are separate experiments
